queue.title: The Reorder Is Everything
queue.description: Getting onto the shelf feels like the win. In beverage, the shelf is rented, and the only rent that counts is velocity. The reorder is the whole game.

queue.title: The Last Two Weeks
queue.description: How someone behaves during their notice period is one of the most honest signals in hiring, and almost nobody asks about it.

queue.title: The Candidate Already In The Building
queue.description: Companies run expensive external searches while overlooking people already doing the job down the hall, and the reasons are more psychological than practical.

queue.title: The Promotion Nobody Asked For
queue.description: Why moving your best performer into management often costs you two people instead of gaining one, and what to check before you do it.
